product.title: Antelope Canyon Horseshoe Bend Day Tour from Las Vegas

description.text: Leave Las Vegas before sunrise for a full-day desert loop that pairs two signature Southwest sights in one guided outing. After a scenic drive toward Page, stretch your legs on the hike to Horseshoe Bend, then continue to Antelope Canyon for a Navajo-led walk through sculpted sandstone corridors with dedicated photo stops. Round-trip transport, canyon admission, and lunch are handled so you can focus on the landscapes instead of logistics.

highlights: Visit Horseshoe Bend and Antelope Canyon in one long day from Las Vegas.
Travel by air-conditioned coach with onboard Wi-Fi and bottled water.
Join a Navajo guide in Antelope Canyon for photo-forward canyon access.
Lunch and core admission fees are included in the day-trip package.
inclusions: Pick-up and drop off from Treasure Island Las Vegas
additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking.
Voucher and valid photo ID are required for check-in.
All children 17 years of age or under must be accompanied by an adult.
Guests must be able to walk unassisted on uneven surfaces and steep inclines.
Antelope Canyon does not allow hiking sticks, canes, walkers, or wheelchairs.
Pets and service animals are not allowed.
This tour/activity will have a maximum of 55 travelers.

meetingPoint.description: Treasure Island Tour Bus pick-up area is on Mystere Dreams Ave, west of Valet and Starbucks, at the yellow-curbed sidewalk. Additional pickup locations are available by request.
meetingPoint.name: Treasure Island Las Vegas - TI Hotel & Casino, 3300 Las Vegas Blvd S, Las Vegas, NV 89109

itineraryItems.title: Horseshoe Bend
itineraryItems.description: Walk the round-trip trail to the overlook above the Colorado River bend and take in panoramic canyon views.

itineraryItems.title: Antelope Canyon
itineraryItems.description: Follow a Navajo guide through your assigned canyon section (Upper, Lower, or X) with time for photos.

faqs.question: How do I arrange hotel pickup for the Antelope Canyon & Horseshoe Bend tour?
faqs.answer: Pickup is available from multiple Las Vegas Strip, Fremont Street, and off-Strip locations. Select your preferred pickup point when booking and confirm final details at least 24 hours before departure.
